title: Meta removes “train” from allowed use cases while still permitting broad website scraping that may supersede robots.txt
content:
X author: @NiemanLab

Meta revised its terms on Friday by removing the word “train” from a list of allowed use cases and limiting remaining uses to advertising and business products. Legal experts say the changes still permit broad scraping of websites and could override robots.txt files.
